description: This file defines the GrainDirectoryAttribute class, which is an attribute used to specify the grain directory provider for a grain class in Orleans. It includes constructors, a property for the directory name, and a method to populate grain properties.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
classes.description: An attribute that specifies the grain directory provider to use for the decorated grain class.

methods.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a default or specified grain directory name.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates the grain properties dictionary with the grain directory name.
